Are you someone who recently gave your life to Jesus?
Are you someone who has questions about God?
Are you someone who doesn’t go to church but are curious about what we talk about?

If you answered yes to any of these, THIS CLASS IS FOR YOU! :)

Explore what Jesus said and did, and learn what that might mean for your life. We believe the best decisions are the most informed decisions. At Alpha, you can explore the Christian faith in the context of conversation, questions, and community.

This class meets on Tuesday nights from 6:00pm - 8:00pm in the south wing at Cornerstone. 

The first class is Tuesday, September 22, 2026. 

You will receive a book on the first night of class and there is a $5, one time, recommended donation which will go directly to running the class each week.

attributes.description:
The Cornerstone Foundation is a faith ministry with a mission to keep all people safe, fed, housed and clothed. We provide help to the community with a soup kitchen, two shelters, a food pantry, clothing bank, youth/outreach center and many vital annual initiatives.
​
Cornerstone has provided food, clothing and shelter to those in need for over 40 years with the help of mostly all volunteers.  
 
We have grown from a nightly homeless shelter at Sacred Heart Church's former library, to a Soup Kitchen and now presently -- five programs and ministries in five buildings in Rockville, Connecticut.

We have many areas to serve:

To serve thousands of people on a regular basis, we have many volunteers who donate their time in our five ministries. We currently need volunteers to help with our Youth Outreach.

If you have a specific talent or skill to lend a hand let us know. The upkeep of our buildings is always a challenge and expertise in plumbing, electric, painting, etc. is always a blessing.

To volunteer, please click HERE.

attributes.description:
We want our kids to have encounters with the Lord, we want them applying the Word to their everyday life, we want them to passionately pursue God in prayer and worship! We believe the Holy Spirit is speaking to them and has a powerful plan for each of their lives! 

We love their sense of adventure, their desire to learn and their excitement for life!

Our gatherings are centered around teaching children about Jesus and having fun at the same time! In creative ways, using object lessons, media, skit and puppets, we teach them the living and powerful word of God and how to apply it to their daily lives. 

Taking a stand for Jesus in this world is not easy, and that is why we co-partner with the families because we believe that the family is the building block of the church and that equipping them to be the chief disciple makers of their children will produce a strong unit that influences the world.  

Ages range from 2 - 12 y/o

attributes.description:
Evidence that evil is flourishing faces Christians every day, leaving many feeling hopeless and helpless. What they don't realize, says esteemed pastor Jack Hayford, is the power that is theirs through the cross. Instead, they labor under the misconception that spiritual warfare occurred only during biblical times.

But it is right here, right now, says Pastor Jack. And for the first time he lays out the strategies he's learned for engaging and defeating evil--through prayer. With clarity and passion, he shows readers how to

• develop powerful devotional habits
• engage in intercession
• plead the blood of Christ
• understand the correct use of binding and loosing
• confront evil
• learn why some prayers don't succeed
• and much more

When believers embrace the cross's power, they will stand up in hope and light against the evil of this world, penetrating even the deepest places where the enemy's darkness dwells.

attributes.description:
This group is for women only.

An irresistible call for Christian women to live boldly and fully into their God-given wisdom, power, and capabilities.

The lioness rises from her slumber, a magnificent image of strength, passion, and beauty. Her mere presence commands the landscape, protects her young, and empowers the lion. In groups, lionesses become a creative and strategic force to be reckoned with, acting as one to change the world around them.

You too are a lioness.

In Lioness Arising, author and speaker Lisa Bevere offers the life and image of the lioness as a fierce and tender model for women. Revealing the surprising characteristics of this amazing creature, Lisa challenges women to discover fresh passion, prowess, and purpose.

Learn what it means to:

• be a stunning representation of strength
• fiercely protect the young
• lend your voice to the silenced
• live in the light and hunt in the dark
• raise a collective roar that changes everything

Packed with remarkable insights from nature and a rich depth of biblical references to lionesses, Lioness Arising is a call for women to rise up in strength and numbers to change their world.

Jesus is, after all, the lion of the Tribe of Judah.

We are his lioness arising.

Link to Purchase: https://www.amazon.com/Lioness-Arising-Wake-Change-World/dp/0307457796/ref=sr_1_1?crid=1U1E3C10KSK6&dib=eyJ2IjoiMSJ9.CXCA0gp1RWO5ZYw8NZWYok_xLRh4AjU1Adk6M1TnZMhTgOh9l2cNa_8p5g8h59es.kqXkI8ao61l2KGFCB-kEUwOjBswPJZLIKAGdqdKJg60&dib_tag=se&keywords=lioness+arising+lisa+bevere+workbook&qid=1788557619&sprefix=lioness+ar,aps,110&sr=8-1

The cost is $50/girl for the semester. However, please let us know if a scholarship is needed.

Any dancer who does not yet have a HP shirt and tambourine will receive their own to keep.

attributes.description:
For many Jewish Christians of the first century, living in the light of the gospel was challenging. Having accepted Jesus as the long-awaited Messiah, they were regarded by still-skeptical family, friends and neighbors as dangerous, misguided and even disloyal to all that God had said earlier on. The letter to the Hebrews was written to show that you can't go back to an earlier stage of God's purposes but must press on eagerly to the one that is yet to come. In these studies by Tom Wright we find encouragement and assurance that pressing on, even in the face of such close and constant pressure to fall back, is its own reward.

attributes.description:
In his bestselling book, Gentle and Lowly, Dane Ortlund takes readers into the depths of Christ’s very heart for sinners. Focusing on Jesus’s words that he is “gentle and lowly in heart,” Ortlund dives deep into Bible passages that speak of who he most deeply is, encouraging readers with the affections of Christ for his people.

Designed to be used in conjunction with the book, the Gentle and Lowly Study Guide helps readers reflect further on this wondrous biblical reality. attributes.description:
Dinner and childcare are provided!

Are you tired of the cycle of yelling, power struggles, bedtime and sibling battles? Do you sometimes find yourself losing your own calm when your child’s emotions get too big?

Psalms 127:4 tells us, “Like arrows in the hands of warrior are children born in one’s youth.” As parents and caregivers, we have the privilege to guide, strengthen, and prepare our children to become all that God has created them to be.

Join us for a transformative 8-week parenting series that bridges brain science, relationship building, and Biblical stewardship. This series combines the principles of Circle of Security with the practical tools of Calm Connected Parenting to help you better understand what your child needs when they are struggling. The last 4 weeks will also include a Live Play Lab—a hands-on space to practice learned skills and build confidence with support and coaching. Together building the tools needed to begin sharpening your arrows with greater intention, while keeping your family firmly anchored in the patient, unconditional love of Christ.

We hope you join us!

attributes.description:
The Springfield Pregnancy Care Center is a non-profit volunteer agency whose purpose is to provide support and assistance during the challenges of facing an unplanned pregnancy.

Our staff, familiar with the stresses confronting women, is prepared to offer a myriad of services from free pregnancy testing to maternity and baby clothes to temporary housing. 

Founded in 1985, SPCC has served the women of the Pioneer Valley area for more than 25 years.  All of the Center's services are offered free of charge, and strict confidentiality is maintained.

There are many ways to volunteer: receptionist, translator, handyman, peer counselor, fundraising, and many more.  You could also hold a baby shower to collect clothes and supplies or donate new or gently used clothes.

If you are interested, call 413-732-2006.

No person is denied services based on race, creed, gender, or nationality.
